diagnostic_evidence.quote: Now that the estimates for all term appearing in \eqref{eq:FullyDiscErrRek} are given, we can finish the proof as in the semi-discrete case above.

issues.failure_explanation: In the proof of Theorem ThmStrangFully the term \tilde P_n is estimated via \|(I-I_K)g(\pi_Nu(t_n))\|_{\ell^1 L^q} \lesssim K^{-1}\|g(\pi_Nu(t_n))\|_{\ell^1 W^{1,q}} with q = 2 (energy norm) and q = 6/5 (L^2×H^{-1} norm), and the W^{1,q} norm is then bounded by the first-order product \|g'(\pi_Nu)\|_{L^a}\|\pi_N\nabla u\|_{L^b}. Since g(w) = -\mu w^\alpha, the full W^{1,q} norm contains the zero-order part \|g(w)\|_{L^q} = \|w^\alpha\|_{L^q}, which is not dominated by that product: for admissible data with nonzero spatial mean c the product can be made arbitrarily small (it contains a factor \|\pi_N\nabla u\|) while \|g(\pi_Nu)\|_{L^2} ≈ c^α stays bounded away from zero. The displayed inference is therefore invalid, and the announced bounds \|\tilde P_n\| ≲ K^{-1/2} (energy norm) and K^{-1} (L^2×H^{-1} norm), which feed the α = 4 iteration argument, are not established by the given reasoning.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound the zero-order part of the Sobolev norm separately — \|g(π_Nu(t))\|_{L^q} ≤ C\|π_Nu(t)\|_{L^6}^α ≲ M^α for q ∈ {2, 6/5} by Hölder/Sobolev — and add it to the displayed first-order product before applying Lemmas LemTrigIntStab/LemTrigIntError; the same rates K^{-1/2} and K^{-1} then result and the α = 4 iteration finishes unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the α = 4 fully discrete error bound in Theorem ThmStrangFully is incomplete: the estimates for the interpolation-error term \tilde P_n in both the energy norm and the L^2×H^{-1} norm are unsupported as displayed, so the announced fully discrete rates C(τ^{3/2}+K^{-1}) (and the spatial optimality claim in the surrounding prose) are not established by the given argument.
issues.title: Unjustified control of the W^{1,q} norm of g(π_Nu) by a pure first-order product in the fully discrete proof
issues.why_classification: A short local repair (estimating the zero-order term ‖g(π_Nu)‖_{L^q} ≲ M^α separately and adding it to the displayed product) preserves every substantive claim, rate, and guarantee of Theorem ThmStrangFully; no new lemma, construction, or proof architecture is required.
